if_the_registry_is_unreachable: docker/pcb/build-image.sh rebuilds the image from the recipe (all inputs are pinned); then `docker/pcb/image-id.sh installed pcb-tools:<kicad>-r<current>` must print the installed-set hash above and the recipe must equal the recipe above. The layer content hash will differ, so use DUE_PCB_IMAGE=pcb-tools:<kicad>-r<current>: run.sh then labels every row image=UNPINNED:<tag> and bench.py will not write budgets from it. The installed-set equality is the claim; do not take a figure of record from an unpinned image.
